sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》节目。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: When the New York Times showed that Donald Trump may have used a legal loophole
sentences.zh: 当《纽约时报》披露唐纳德·特朗普可能利用法律漏洞

sentences.en: to avoid paying federal income taxes for years,
sentences.zh: 多年来规避缴纳联邦所得税时，

sentences.en: many people expected the self-described billionaire to be embarrassed.
sentences.zh: 许多人以为这位自称亿万富翁的人会感到尴尬。

sentences.en: Instead, in a debate with Hillary Clinton, Donald Trump said,
sentences.zh: 然而，在与希拉里·克林顿的辩论中，唐纳德·特朗普却说：

sentences.en: He didn't pay any federal income tax.
sentences.zh: 他没交过任何联邦所得税。

sentences.en: So if he's paid zero, that means zero...
sentences.zh: 如果他交了零，那就意味着零……

sentences.en: That makes me smart.
sentences.zh: 这说明我很聪明。

sentences.en: It got us thinking about a new book by Brooke Harrington,
sentences.zh: 这让我们想到了布鲁克·哈林顿的一本新书，

sentences.en: a sociologist at the Copenhagen Business School in Denmark.
sentences.zh: 她是丹麦哥本哈根商学院的一位社会学家。

sentences.en: She decided several years ago to explore the secret lives of billionaires.
sentences.zh: 几年前，她决定去探索亿万富翁们的秘密生活。

sentences.en: She took an unusual path to enter this world.
sentences.zh: 她走了一条不同寻常的道路进入这个世界。

sentences.en: She herself trained to become a wealth manager.
sentences.zh: 她亲自接受培训，成为了一名财富管理师。

sentences.en: In the course of this training, she gained unprecedented access to other wealth managers
sentences.zh: 在培训过程中，她获得了前所未有的机会去接触其他财富管理师，

sentences.en: who agreed to be interviewed for her research.
sentences.zh: 他们同意接受她的研究访谈。

sentences.en: She discovered that in order to manage money for the super-rich,
sentences.zh: 她发现，为了替超级富豪管理资金，

sentences.en: these professionals also learn a lot about the private lives of their clients.
sentences.zh: 这些专业人士也了解了客户私生活的许多方面。

sentences.en: What they shared, Brooke says, shocked her.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克说，他们分享的内容让她感到震惊。

sentences.en: The lives of the richest people in the world are so different from those of the rest of us,
sentences.zh: 世界上最富有的人的生活与我们其他人截然不同，

sentences.en: it's almost literally unimaginable.
sentences.zh: 简直到了无法想象的地步。

sentences.en: National borders are nothing to them.
sentences.zh: 国界对他们来说毫无意义。

sentences.en: They might as well not exiSt.
sentences.zh: 它们简直形同虚设。

sentences.en: The laws are nothing to them.
sentences.zh: 法律对他们来说也毫无意义。

sentences.en: They might as well not exiSt.
sentences.zh: 它们简直形同虚设。

sentences.en: Today on Hidden Brain, the sociology and psychology of some members of the billionaire class
sentences.zh: 今天在《隐藏的大脑》节目中，我们将探讨亿万富翁阶层中某些成员的社会学和心理学，

sentences.en: and the professionals who enable them.
sentences.zh: 以及那些为他们提供便利的专业人士。

sentences.en: Brooke Harrington, welcome to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克·哈林顿，欢迎来到《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me on the show.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我参加节目。

sentences.en: For wealth managers to do their job, Brooke, I understand that they need to find out everything
sentences.zh: 布鲁克，据我了解，财富管理师要完成工作，需要了解客户生活的方方面面，

sentences.en: about a client's life, not just a client's financial life, but everything about their life.
sentences.zh: 不仅是财务生活，而是关于他们生活的一切。

sentences.en: Give me some examples of the kind of conversations people have with wealth managers
sentences.zh: 能给我举几个例子吗？人们会和财富管理师进行什么样的对话，

sentences.en: and the kind of issues they bring up about their personal circumstances
sentences.zh: 以及他们会提出哪些关于个人情况的问题，

sentences.en: that might affect how their wealth is managed.
sentences.zh: 这些问题可能会影响他们的财富管理方式。

sentences.en: Well, it usually starts with what's called know-your-client activity.
sentences.zh: 嗯，通常从所谓的“了解你的客户”活动开始。

sentences.en: So if you were to come to me, with me acting as the wealth manager,
sentences.zh: 如果你来找我，而我担任你的财富管理师，

sentences.en: I would first ask to see some proof of identity, like your passport,
sentences.zh: 我首先会要求看一些身份证明，比如你的护照，

sentences.en: and then we would talk about what goals you had for your wealth.
sentences.zh: 然后我们会讨论你对财富的目标。

sentences.en: And that begins the series of increasingly delicate and increasingly intrusive questions.
sentences.zh: 接着就是一系列越来越微妙、越来越具有侵入性的问题。

sentences.en: Then usually we get into whatever real reason is bringing you to me.
sentences.zh: 通常我们会进入你找我的真正原因。

sentences.en: Maybe you want to avoid your taxes.
sentences.zh: 也许你想避税。

sentences.en: Maybe you really don't like your family.
sentences.zh: 也许你真的很讨厌你的家人。

sentences.en: That's surprisingly common among wealthy people.
sentences.zh: 这在富人中出奇地普遍。

sentences.en: For example, if you have a relative or if you yourself are engaging in some activity
sentences.zh: 例如，如果你有亲戚或者你自己正在从事某种活动，

sentences.en: that might get you extorted, it may not be illegal, but it might be socially shameful.
sentences.zh: 可能会让你遭到勒索，这可能不违法，但可能在社会上很丢脸。

sentences.en: That's a financial risk that your wealth manager needs to know about.
sentences.zh: 那是你的财富管理师需要了解的财务风险。

sentences.en: If you have a son or daughter with a drug problem,
sentences.zh: 如果你有儿子或女儿有毒瘾，

sentences.en: that's a financial risk that your wealth manager needs to know about.
sentences.zh: 那是你的财富管理师需要了解的财务风险。

sentences.en: There can also be issues like, I think I'm headed for a divorce,
sentences.zh: 也可能存在这样的问题：我觉得我要离婚了，

sentences.en: but I don't want my spouse to get half my assets.
sentences.zh: 但我不想让配偶分走我一半的资产。

sentences.en: How do I hide those assets, preferably offshore,
sentences.zh: 我该如何隐藏这些资产，最好是放在离岸账户，

sentences.en: so that whatever is legally provable as mine is such a small amount that it's not worth fighting about?
sentences.zh: 这样在法律上能证明是我的资产就少到不值得争抢了？

sentences.en: So it's really interesting because these professionals in some ways get to know their clients
sentences.zh: 这真的很有趣，因为这些专业人士在某种程度上比客户的家人、朋友甚至配偶

sentences.en: better than the client's own family or friends or even their own spouse.
sentences.zh: 更了解客户。

sentences.en: Yes, it's apparently something of a cliche in the offshore world that the average client is a man in his 50s
sentences.zh: 是的，在离岸世界里这似乎是个陈词滥调，典型的客户是一位50多岁的男性，

sentences.en: with a secret family somewhere.
sentences.zh: 在某个地方有个秘密家庭。

sentences.en: Might be a gay lover, might be a common law wife and some children,
sentences.zh: 可能是同性恋人，可能是事实婚姻的妻子和一些孩子，

sentences.en: but there are usually all sorts of secrets that these wealthy folks wish to keep hidden
sentences.zh: 但通常这些富人都有各种各样的秘密想要隐藏，

sentences.en: and that they have the additional privilege of being able to hire people to take care of in secret.
sentences.zh: 而且他们还有额外的特权，可以雇人秘密处理这些事情。

sentences.en: So I understand you conducted about 65 interviews in 18 countries for this book.
sentences.zh: 我了解到你为这本书在18个国家进行了大约65次访谈。

sentences.en: Tell me a little bit about the people you met.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说你遇到的人吧。

sentences.en: To be a wealth manager, you have to understand finance and the law,
sentences.zh: 要成为一名财富管理师，你必须了解金融和法律，

sentences.en: but this kind of role also calls for a certain psychological makeup.
sentences.zh: 但这种角色也需要特定的心理素质。

sentences.en: What kind of person becomes a wealth manager?
sentences.zh: 什么样的人会成为财富管理师？

sentences.en: Well, several of the people I spoke to describe themselves in only somewhat joking terms
sentences.zh: 嗯，我采访的几个人半开玩笑地形容自己是

sentences.en: as social workers for the rich.
sentences.zh: 富人的社会工作者。

sentences.en: So you have to have empathy and a desire to help people,
sentences.zh: 所以你必须有同理心和帮助他人的愿望，

sentences.en: but also a very high tolerance for people who would otherwise seem to be so extremely privileged
sentences.zh: 但也要对那些看起来极其优越的人有很高的容忍度，

sentences.en: that you might be otherwise inclined to smack them around and say, snap out of it.
sentences.zh: 否则你可能会想给他们一巴掌，说：清醒点吧。

sentences.en: You're lucky.
sentences.zh: 你很幸运。

sentences.en: You write in your book about the extreme lengths that some managers go to please their clients
sentences.zh: 你在书中写到，一些经理为了取悦客户或为客户提供服务，

sentences.en: or to provide services to their clients.
sentences.zh: 会不惜一切代价。

sentences.en: You write about a manager named Eleanor in Geneva
sentences.zh: 你写到日内瓦一位名叫埃莉诺的经理，

sentences.en: who said that one of her clients once called her from outside a restaurant in London.
sentences.zh: 她说她的一位客户曾从伦敦一家餐馆外给她打电话。

sentences.en: Tell me that story.
sentences.zh: 讲讲那个故事吧。

sentences.en: So this is one of the first stories that I heard that really made my eyebrows raise.
sentences.zh: 这是我听到的第一个让我大吃一惊的故事。

sentences.en: It was while I was training to be a wealth manager.
sentences.zh: 那是在我接受财富管理师培训的时候。

sentences.en: Eleanor told this story over lunch of receiving a phone call from a client who was in another country
sentences.zh: 埃莉诺在午餐时讲了这个故事，说她接到一个在国外的客户打来的电话，

sentences.en: saying, I've just lost my bracelet outside of a restaurant.
sentences.zh: 说：我刚在一家餐馆外丢了手镯。

sentences.en: Help me find it.
sentences.zh: 帮我找回来。

sentences.en: And the client didn't identify the restaurant by name.
sentences.zh: 而且客户没有说出餐馆的名字。

sentences.en: So imagine having someone call you from another country.
sentences.zh: 想象一下有人从另一个国家给你打电话。

sentences.en: I mean, obviously the country was identified, but not anything remotely approaching a location.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，显然国家是确定了，但根本没有任何接近具体位置的信息。

sentences.en: So you have to sort of marvel at the immaturity of the client expecting someone else
sentences.zh: 所以你不得不感叹客户的幼稚，竟然指望别人

sentences.en: to help her fix a problem like this.
sentences.zh: 帮她解决这样的问题。

sentences.en: But Eleanor somehow did it.
sentences.zh: 但埃莉诺不知怎么就做到了。

sentences.en: She determined where the client was and what exactly had been lost
sentences.zh: 她确定了客户在哪里，到底丢了什么，

sentences.en: and got the local authorities on the case, found the bracelet, and billed the client for all the time.
sentences.zh: 并让当地有关部门介入，找到了手镯，还向客户收取了所有时间的费用。

sentences.en: And apparently the client was happy to pay.
sentences.zh: 显然客户很乐意买单。

sentences.en: There are sometimes clients do make requests like this, not because they are acting childish,
sentences.zh: 有时客户提出这样的要求，并不是因为他们表现得幼稚，

sentences.en: but because they actually have an ulterior motive.
sentences.zh: 而是因为他们确实有不可告人的动机。

sentences.en: They actually want to test the loyalties or ability of the wealth manager.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上是想测试财富管理师的忠诚度或能力。

sentences.en: You tell the story of a wealth manager in Hong Kong named David.
sentences.zh: 你讲了一个香港财富管理师大卫的故事。

sentences.en: Yes, he got a call early on in his relationship with the client in which the client said that he was in Japan
sentences.zh: 是的，他在与客户建立关系的早期接到一个电话，客户说他在日本，

sentences.en: and he was meeting with a Japanese gentleman who had expressed a desire for smoked salmon
sentences.zh: 正在见一位日本绅士，对方表示想要烟熏三文鱼，

sentences.en: and that this client had promised him, I think, a thousand sides of smoked salmon straight from the factory in Scotland
sentences.zh: 而这位客户承诺给他，我想是，一千片直接从苏格兰工厂运来的烟熏三文鱼，

sentences.en: and was now calling David saying, get me the salmon.
sentences.zh: 现在他打电话给大卫说：给我弄到三文鱼。

sentences.en: And David said, well, I'm your wealth manager, not your fishmonger.
sentences.zh: 大卫说：我是你的财富管理师，不是鱼贩子。

sentences.en: And the client said, well, today you're the fishmonger.
sentences.zh: 客户说：好吧，今天你就是鱼贩子。

sentences.en: And so David happens to know someone who knew the head of the smoked salmon factory in Scotland
sentences.zh: 于是大卫碰巧认识一个了解苏格兰烟熏三文鱼工厂负责人的人，

sentences.en: and he fulfilled the client's wish.
sentences.zh: 他满足了客户的愿望。

sentences.en: And the client later told him, I basically made up that story.
sentences.zh: 客户后来告诉他：我基本上是编造了那个故事。

sentences.en: I wasn't sitting across from a Japanese fellow who wanted a thousand sides of smoked salmon.
sentences.zh: 我并没有坐在一个想要一千片烟熏三文鱼的日本人对面。

sentences.en: I just needed to see that you had the connections and the will to do what I wanted when I wanted
sentences.zh: 我只是需要看看你是否有门路，以及是否有意愿在我需要的时候做我想做的事，

sentences.en: and not ask any questions.
sentences.zh: 而且不问任何问题。

sentences.en: It was almost a test of his ability to jump in and sort of perform this outlandish request,
sentences.zh: 这几乎是对他能否介入并完成这种离奇要求的测试，

sentences.en: perhaps as a guide to sort of other requests that would come further down the road.
sentences.zh: 也许是作为未来其他要求的参考。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And also it was a test of what kind of powerful social connections this wealth manager might have
sentences.zh: 而且这也是在测试这位财富管理师可能拥有什么样的强大社会关系，

sentences.en: because one of the wealth manager's roles is to set up private markets for deals.
sentences.zh: 因为财富管理师的角色之一就是为交易建立私人市场。

sentences.en: So it's not uncommon for them to have several clients, each of whom owns incredibly valuable real estate,
sentences.zh: 所以他们拥有几位客户并不罕见，每位客户都拥有极其昂贵的房地产、

sentences.en: art collections, yachts, and so forth.
sentences.zh: 艺术收藏品、游艇等等。

sentences.en: And since these clients are very, very concerned about maintaining their privacy,
sentences.zh: 由于这些客户非常、非常关心维护隐私，

sentences.en: they don't want to list these things on the open market for sale.
sentences.zh: 他们不想把这些东西放在公开市场上出售。

sentences.en: If they need to raise cash, they want to do the sales as quietly, as discreetly as possible
sentences.zh: 如果他们需要筹集现金，他们希望尽可能安静、谨慎地进行销售，

sentences.en: with as little public recording as possible.
sentences.zh: 尽可能少地进行公开记录。

sentences.en: One thing that I got from your book is that there are important ways in which the very rich
sentences.zh: 我从你的书中得到的一点是，超级富豪在某些重要方面

sentences.en: are very much like the rest of us and ways in which they're not.
sentences.zh: 和我们其他人很像，但在某些方面又不像。

sentences.en: So wealthy people, unsurprisingly, turn out to have troubled marriages and wayward children
sentences.zh: 所以，不出所料，富人也有婚姻问题和不听话的孩子，

sentences.en: just like, you know, everybody else.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道的，其他人一样。

sentences.en: But wealth, you argue, can compound those challenges.
sentences.zh: 但你认为，财富可能会加剧这些挑战。

sentences.en: Well, apparently it's not uncommon for the wealth manager to be asked to find or recommend rehab facilities for kids.
sentences.zh: 嗯，显然财富管理师被要求为孩子寻找或推荐康复中心并不罕见。

sentences.en: Or a parent will ask a wealth manager to break some bad news to the next generation, to his or her own children.
sentences.zh: 或者父母会要求财富管理师向下一代，也就是他或她自己的孩子，传达一些坏消息。

sentences.en: Sometimes the wealth manager has to broker a truce between feuding family members.
sentences.zh: 有时财富管理师必须在闹矛盾的家庭成员之间进行调解。

sentences.en: Say one family member feels that they've been done by unfairly in the inheritance plan
sentences.zh: 比如某个家庭成员觉得在遗产计划中受到了不公平对待，

sentences.en: and has to be somehow brought back in so that they don't sue the family.
sentences.zh: 必须以某种方式被安抚，这样他们就不会起诉家庭。

sentences.en: The big risk here is if you have a disgruntled family member who sues.
sentences.zh: 这里最大的风险是，如果你有一个心怀不满的家庭成员提起诉讼。

sentences.en: The lawsuit process in many countries makes public many, many private documents
sentences.zh: 在许多国家，诉讼过程会公开许多许多私人文件，

sentences.en: that would reveal the extent and nature of a family's wealth,
sentences.zh: 这些文件会揭露家庭财富的规模和性质，

sentences.en: all of which have been carefully guarded secrets.
sentences.zh: 而这些一直都是被严密守护的秘密。

sentences.en: When we come back, I'm going to talk to Brooke about how the rich lead very different lives than you and I.
sentences.zh: 回来后，我将和布鲁克谈谈富人是如何过着与你我截然不同的生活的。

sentences.en: They don't just eat differently and travel differently and live in bigger homes.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅仅是吃得不同、旅行方式不同、住的房子更大。

sentences.en: They sometimes play by an entirely different set of rules.
sentences.zh: 他们有时遵循一套完全不同的规则。

sentences.en: Stay with us.
sentences.zh: 请继续收听。

sentences.en: My guest today is a sociologist, Brooke Harrington.
sentences.zh: 我今天的嘉宾是社会学家布鲁克·哈林顿。

sentences.en: She spent years trying to understand the lives of people who are so wealthy
sentences.zh: 她花了多年时间试图了解那些极其富有的人的生活，

sentences.en: that they're able to circumvent the constraints of national laws and borders.
sentences.zh: 以至于他们能够规避国家法律和边界的限制。

sentences.en: In the course of her many interviews with wealth managers,
sentences.zh: 在与财富管理师进行的多次访谈中，

sentences.en: Brooke talked to one professional in Switzerland who told her a revealing story.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克与瑞士的一位专业人士交谈，对方告诉她一个发人深省的故事。

sentences.en: So this wealth manager and her boss had been summoned to a country outside of Europe
sentences.zh: 这位财富管理师和她的老板被欧洲以外的一个国家的客户传唤，

sentences.en: by a client who was sending a private plane for them.
sentences.zh: 客户派了一架私人飞机去接他们。

sentences.en: She showed up at the Zurich airport with her boss waiting for this plane
sentences.zh: 她和老板出现在苏黎世机场等待这架飞机，

sentences.en: and she discovered that she'd left her passport back home in a different purse
sentences.zh: 结果发现她把护照忘在家里另一个包里了，

sentences.en: and she said to her boss,
sentences.zh: 她对老板说：

sentences.en: I've got to go home and get my passport because we're leaving Europe.
sentences.zh: 我得回家拿护照，因为我们要离开欧洲了。

sentences.en: And he said, don't worry about it.
sentences.zh: 他说：别担心。

sentences.en: And she said again, no, they're going to check my passport.
sentences.zh: 她又说：不，他们会检查我的护照。

sentences.en: They won't let me leave Switzerland, much less enter another country.
sentences.zh: 他们不会让我离开瑞士，更不用说进入另一个国家了。

sentences.en: I've got to go home.
sentences.zh: 我得回家。

sentences.en: And he said, no, really, don't worry about it.
sentences.zh: 他说：不，真的，别担心。

sentences.en: So she didn't say anything further, figuring, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以她没再多说什么，心想，你知道的，

sentences.en: it would be his problem if she got refused the right to leave.
sentences.zh: 如果她被拒绝离境，那将是他的麻烦。

sentences.en: Sure enough, the private plane pulls up.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，私人飞机开过来了。

sentences.en: They get on it.
sentences.zh: 他们登上了飞机。

sentences.en: Nobody checks a passport.
sentences.zh: 没人检查护照。

sentences.en: It lands in this other country outside Europe.
sentences.zh: 飞机降落在欧洲以外的另一个国家。

sentences.en: Nobody checks a passport.
sentences.zh: 没人检查护照。

sentences.en: They get into the private car sent by the client.
sentences.zh: 他们坐上了客户派来的私家车。

sentences.en: They're taken to the client's home.
sentences.zh: 他们被带到了客户家中。

sentences.en: They have their meeting.
sentences.zh: 他们进行了会面。

sentences.en: Private car takes them back to the private plane.
sentences.zh: 私家车又把他们送回了私人飞机上。

sentences.en: Private plane flies them back to Switzerland.
sentences.zh: 私人飞机把他们送回了瑞士。

sentences.en: They get off the plane and go home.
sentences.zh: 他们下了飞机，各自回家。

sentences.en: At no point has anyone encountered passport control or a customs agent.
sentences.zh: 全程没有任何人遇到过护照检查或海关人员。

sentences.en: And this wealth manager's comment was,
sentences.zh: 而这位财富管理经理的评论是，

sentences.en: the lives of the richest people in the world are so different from those of the rest of us.
sentences.zh: 世界上最富有的人的生活与我们其他人截然不同。

sentences.en: It's almost literally unimaginable.
sentences.zh: 这简直是无法想象的。

sentences.en: National borders are nothing to them.
sentences.zh: 国界对他们来说什么都不是。

sentences.en: They might as well not exiSt.
sentences.zh: 它们简直形同虚设。

sentences.en: The laws are nothing to them.
sentences.zh: 法律对他们来说什么都不是。

sentences.en: They might as well not exiSt.
sentences.zh: 它们简直形同虚设。

sentences.en: It's potentially very, very dangerous.
sentences.zh: 这可能非常、非常危险。

sentences.en: And I think she's right about that.
sentences.zh: 我认为她在这点上是对的。

sentences.en: You spoke with a wealth manager named Dieter.
sentences.zh: 你采访了一位名叫迪特（Dieter）的财富管理经理。

sentences.en: I think this was a German wealth manager who talked about how his job allowed him to schmooze with powerful people,
sentences.zh: 我想这是一位德国财富管理经理，他谈到他的工作如何让他能够与权贵们打成一片，

sentences.en: but also in some ways discover things about foreign countries before even the citizens of those countries would find out about those important things.
sentences.zh: 但在某些方面，他甚至能在那些国家的公民发现重要事情之前，就先了解到有关外国的情况。

sentences.en: Yeah, he was very proud of the fact that when he was working in Africa,
sentences.zh: 是的，他非常自豪的一点是，当他在非洲工作时，

sentences.en: he would have parties and the heads of state of the various countries he lived in would come to his house and he'd get them drunk.
sentences.zh: 他会举办派对，他所居住的各个国家的国家元首都会来他家，他会把他们灌醉。

sentences.en: And they'd be spilling state secrets by two in the morning.
sentences.zh: 凌晨两点，他们就会吐露国家机密。

sentences.en: And then people like Catherine Graham, the late publisher of the Washington Post, would call him up for advice.
sentences.zh: 然后像凯瑟琳·格雷厄姆（Catherine Graham），也就是已故的《华盛顿邮报》发行人，会打电话向他咨询建议。

sentences.en: And, you know, he could speak authoritatively about at least affairs in some African countries
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他至少能权威地谈论一些非洲国家的事务，

sentences.en: because he'd heard it directly from the mouths of the people who made those policies.
sentences.zh: 因为他是直接从那些制定政策的人口中听到的。

sentences.en: It reminds me a little bit about what we learned when the Panama Papers scandal broke.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了一点我们在“巴拿马文件”丑闻爆发时所了解到的情况。

sentences.en: I kept seeing photos or drawings of the faces of people whose names turned up in the Panama Papers.
sentences.zh: 我一直看到那些名字出现在“巴拿马文件”中的人的照片或画像。

sentences.en: And it was really a rogues' gallery of people from all walks of life, as well as heads of state and corporate leaders,
sentences.zh: 那真是一个各行各业人士、国家元首和企业领袖的“流氓画廊”，

sentences.en: people who you would think have nothing in common with each other.
sentences.zh: 这些人你本以为他们之间毫无共同点。

sentences.en: But at one level, the fact that they are so rich gives them these very important things in common,
sentences.zh: 但在某种层面上，他们如此富有这一事实，使他们有了这些非常重要的共同点，

sentences.en: which is to say, for them, national boundaries and laws are all optional.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，对他们而言，国界和法律都是可选的。

sentences.en: Taxes are optional.
sentences.zh: 纳税是可选的。

sentences.en: All forms of law are essentially optional at that level of wealth.
sentences.zh: 在那种财富水平下，所有形式的法律本质上都是可选的。

sentences.en: So this has come up recently in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以这最近在美国总统大选中被提了出来，

sentences.en: presidential election when Donald Trump suggested that not paying federal taxes
sentences.zh: 当时唐纳德·特朗普暗示，不缴纳联邦税，

sentences.en: or avoiding federal taxes legally, I might add, for several years made him actually someone who was smart.
sentences.zh: 或者说合法地规避联邦税——我得补充一下——好几年，实际上让他显得很聪明。

sentences.en: He didn't pay any federal income tax.
sentences.zh: 他没有缴纳任何联邦所得税。

sentences.en: So if he's paid zero, that means zero.
sentences.zh: 所以如果他交了零，那就意味着是零。

sentences.en: As you're telling me about these very rich people drawn from different walks of life who have this thing in common,
sentences.zh: 既然你告诉我这些来自不同背景、拥有共同点的超级富豪，

sentences.en: and the fact they're very wealthy, talk a little bit about their attitude toward taxes
sentences.zh: 以及他们非常富有这一事实，谈谈他们对税收的态度，

sentences.en: and their attitude and obligations, in some ways, to footing the common bill.
sentences.zh: 以及他们在某种程度上对分担公共开支的义务的态度。

sentences.en: Some of them actually do sound a lot like Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们中有些人听起来确实很像唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: When I heard Donald Trump say that not paying taxes made him smart
sentences.zh: 当我听到唐纳德·特朗普说不纳税让他显得很聪明，

sentences.en: and that if he had paid his taxes, they would have been wasted anyways,
sentences.zh: 而且如果他交了税，那些钱反正也会被浪费掉时，

sentences.en: I was like, yep, he's the voice of a lot of very wealthy people around the world
sentences.zh: 我就想，没错，他是全世界许多超级富豪的代言人，

sentences.en: and their wealth managers who said essentially the same thing to me.
sentences.zh: 还有那些对我说了基本相同话语的财富管理经理们。

sentences.en: They're very committed to neoliberal ideology
sentences.zh: 他们非常笃信新自由主义意识形态，

sentences.en: and very committed to the idea that these elite clients are doing the world a favor as wealth creators
sentences.zh: 并且非常坚信这些精英客户作为财富创造者是在为世界做贡献，

sentences.en: and that their initiatives should be protected against the government
sentences.zh: 他们的主动权应该受到保护，免受政府的侵害，

sentences.en: and what they regard as theft by taxation,
sentences.zh: 以及他们所认为的通过税收进行的盗窃，

sentences.en: by incompetent governments that would just waste any money they collected anyways.
sentences.zh: 被那些无论如何都会浪费掉所收税款的无能政府所侵害。

sentences.en: They also, by the way, regard redistribution of collected tax as immoral
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，他们还认为重新分配所征收的税款是不道德的，

sentences.en: because it creates dependency on the part of the poor.
sentences.zh: 因为它导致了穷人的依赖性。

sentences.en: So I'm fascinated because what you're saying is that, in effect,
sentences.zh: 我很感兴趣，因为你的意思是，实际上，

sentences.en: the wealthy and their tax managers don't just think they're doing something that's practical and expedient.
sentences.zh: 富人和他们的税务经理不仅仅认为他们是在做一些务实和权宜之计的事情。

sentences.en: You're saying they actually feel like they're doing the moral thing?
sentences.zh: 你是说他们真的觉得自己在做道德上的正确之事？

sentences.en: There is a very strong component of ideology here,
sentences.zh: 这里有一个非常强烈的意识形态成分，

sentences.en: and you see this in the wealth management training program.
sentences.zh: 你在财富管理培训项目中就能看到这一点。

sentences.en: You see it among at least about a quarter of the people I interviewed
sentences.zh: 你在我采访的人中，至少约四分之一的人身上能看到这一点，

sentences.en: really seem to believe quite unironically in the justice of protecting the wealth of their clients from taxation.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎真的非常真诚地相信，保护客户的财富免受税收是正义的。

sentences.en: They literally view taxation as theft,
sentences.zh: 他们从字面上将税收视为盗窃，

sentences.en: and they view government in general as being incompetent at best, corrupt at worst,
sentences.zh: 他们普遍认为政府往好了说是无能，往坏了说是腐败，

sentences.en: and they're deeply suspicious of any sort of welfare state programs
sentences.zh: 他们对任何形式的福利国家计划都深表怀疑，

sentences.en: because they see it as destroying initiative.
sentences.zh: 因为他们认为这会摧毁进取心。

sentences.en: So the picture you've painted for me, Brooke, of the wealth manager
sentences.zh: 所以布鲁克，你为我描绘的财富管理经理的形象，

sentences.en: is someone who is a loyal person, an honest person, a resourceful person, trustworthy,
sentences.zh: 是一个忠诚的人、诚实的人、足智多谋的人、值得信赖的人，

sentences.en: and I fully imagine that lots of wealthy people are probably very good people, high-minded people,
sentences.zh: 我完全可以想象，许多富人可能都是非常好的人、高尚的人，

sentences.en: but I want to talk for a moment about the professionals whose clients are very clearly, you know, sleazebags.
sentences.zh: 但我现在想谈谈那些客户显然是——你知道——卑鄙小人的专业人士。

sentences.en: How do you, as a wealth manager, serve the interests of someone who is cheating his country on taxes,
sentences.zh: 作为一名财富管理经理，你如何为一个在税收上欺骗国家、

sentences.en: cheating on his wife, cheating his employees?
sentences.zh: 背叛妻子、欺诈员工的人服务？

sentences.en: How do you serve a client like that and then go home, tell yourself that you're a good person,
sentences.zh: 你如何为这样的客户服务，然后回家，告诉自己你是个好人，

sentences.en: and sleep well at night?
sentences.zh: 并且晚上睡得安稳？

sentences.en: Well, some of them don't, and I think that's one of the reasons why we're seeing a wave of leaks recently,
sentences.zh: 嗯，有些人做不到，我认为这就是我们最近看到泄密浪潮的原因之一，

sentences.en: that some people are so troubled by what they're seeing that they just can't stomach it any longer,
sentences.zh: 有些人对他们所看到的一切感到非常不安，以至于他们再也无法忍受了，

sentences.en: and they blow the whistle, often with dire personal consequences.
sentences.zh: 于是他们挺身而出举报，往往会带来可怕的个人后果。

sentences.en: About a quarter of the people I interviewed I would characterize as being conscience-stricken
sentences.zh: 我采访的人中大约有四分之一，我会形容他们对工作的更广泛影响感到良心不安。

sentences.en: about the larger impacts of their work.
sentences.zh: 他们有一系列策略来调和这对他们自己良心的影响。

sentences.en: And they had a range of strategies to reconcile themselves to the implications of that for their own conscience.
sentences.zh: 他们处理这个问题的方法之一是鼓励客户向慈善机构捐款，

sentences.en: One of the ways that they dealt with it was to encourage their clients to donate to charity,
sentences.zh: 以抵消剥夺国家收入带来的负面影响。

sentences.en: to offset the negative impact of depriving the state of revenues.
sentences.zh: 我采访的其他一些人，包括巴拿马城的一位绅士，

sentences.en: Other people I interviewed, including one gentleman in Panama City,
sentences.zh: 说他实际上会向客户讲解阿马蒂亚·森（Amartya Sen）和约瑟夫·斯蒂格利茨（Joseph Stiglitz）的著作，

sentences.en: said he would actually lecture his clients on the work of Amartya Sen and Joseph Stiglitz,
sentences.zh: 基本上是关于世界不平等的理论和实践。

sentences.en: basically on the theory and practice of inequality in the world.
sentences.zh: 他会向他们指出，当他们坐在他巴拿马城的办公室里时，

sentences.en: And he would point out to them that as they sat in his office in Panama City,
sentences.zh: 几英里外，人们住在纸板棚屋里，根本喝不上干净的饮用水。

sentences.en: a couple miles away, people were living in cardboard shacks and had no access to clean drinking water.
sentences.zh: 客户对此有什么看法？

sentences.en: And what did the client think about that?
sentences.zh: 现在，这看起来可能很温和，但对于那些习惯了被人阿谀奉承、不被挑战的富人来说，

sentences.en: Now, that may seem mild, but it's a fairly risky strategy to pursue with wealthy people
sentences.zh: 这是一种相当冒险的策略。

sentences.en: who are used to having people fawn over them and not challenge them.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，坦率地说，大多数财富管理经理都是可替代的。

sentences.en: And, you know, frankly, most wealth managers are replaceable.
sentences.zh: 世界上这类人并不多，但如果你发现某个人太让你不爽，

sentences.en: There aren't a lot of them in the world, but if you find one a little too in your face,
sentences.zh: 你总能换一个，或者在另一家公司找一个。

sentences.en: you could always go get another one or get another one within a different company.
sentences.zh: 我想很多人对超级富豪的生活有印象，想象着当你坐着私人飞机到处飞，

sentences.en: I think a lot of people have impressions of the lives of the very wealthy and imagine what life must be like
sentences.zh: 一直有服务人员伺候时，生活会是什么样子。

sentences.en: when you're jetting around in a private plane and being waited on by service staff all the time.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，在你与财富管理经理的交谈中，你对自己关于财富与幸福之间联系的假设或信念，

sentences.en: And I'm wondering in your conversations with wealth managers whether any of your own assumptions
sentences.zh: 是否得到了证实或挑战？

sentences.en: or beliefs about the connections between wealth and happiness were either confirmed or challenged?
sentences.zh: 我采访的一位海峡群岛的男士让我印象深刻，他谈到了富人是多么多疑。

sentences.en: I was struck by a man I spoke to in the Channel Islands who talked about how suspicious wealthy people are.
sentences.zh: 这与我个人看到的一些事情不谋而合。

sentences.en: It jibed with some things that I've seen personally.
sentences.zh: 他说的是，当你真正富有的时候，经历每个人都想从你身上分一杯羹的情况并不罕见。

sentences.en: And what he said was when you're really wealthy, it's not uncommon to have the experience that everyone is out to get a piece of you.
sentences.zh: 就像彩票中奖者遇到的情况一样。

sentences.en: It's like what happens to lottery winners.
sentences.zh: 各种所谓的亲戚都会冒出来要求借钱，要求各种帮助。

sentences.en: All sorts of so-called relatives come out of the woodwork asking for loans, asking for help of some sort.
sentences.zh: 骗子也会冒出来，想从你身上分一杯羹。

sentences.en: Con artists come out of the woodwork looking to get a piece of you.
sentences.zh: 但这就是富人一生中会发生的事情。

sentences.en: But that's what happens throughout the lifetime of wealthy people.
sentences.zh: 所以这滋生了一种怀疑。

sentences.en: And so it breeds a kind of suspicion.
sentences.zh: 你为什么想和我做朋友？

sentences.en: Why do you want to be my friend?
sentences.zh: 你为什么对我这么好？

sentences.en: Why are you being nice to me?
sentences.zh: 你是不是只是想让我给你点什么？

sentences.en: Are you just trying to get me to give you something?
sentences.zh: 那一定非常令人不快。

sentences.en: And that must be very unpleasant.
sentences.zh: 你可以看出这在极端情况下会导致一种霍华德·休斯（Howard Hughes）式的退缩或与人隔绝。

sentences.en: And you can see how that would lead at the extreme to a sort of Howard Hughes-ian retreat or isolation from people.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你不能信任任何人，何必呢？

sentences.en: Because if you can't trust anyone, why bother?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你所说的悲哀之处在于，财富管理经理最终可能成为富人唯一能信任的极少数人之一。

sentences.en: I mean, the sad thing that you're saying is that the wealth manager might end up being perhaps among the very few people that a rich person can truSt.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这似乎是一个常见的故事。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that seems to be a common story.
sentences.zh: 是富人和他们的仆人。

sentences.en: It's wealthy people and their servants.
sentences.zh: 几乎到了这种地步，如果你是一个富人，你比那些你不付钱的人更信任那些你付钱让他们为你服务的人。

sentences.en: It almost comes to the point where you can, if you're a wealthy person, you are more trusting of the people you pay to be in your service than the people you don't pay.
sentences.zh: 因为对于你的家人，你可能会遇到某种“李尔王”式的问题。

sentences.en: Because with your family, you might have sort of a King Lear problem.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的哪个孩子真正爱我，哪些人是想从我这里得到什么。

sentences.en: You know, which of my children actually loves me and which are out to get something from me.
sentences.zh: 但至少当你与员工进行交易关系时，那里的界限是明确的。

sentences.en: But at least when you are having a transactional relationship with an employee, at least the boundaries there are clear.
sentences.zh: 你为他们提供的某些服务付费，你可以评估他们是否按照你要求的标准提供了这些服务。

sentences.en: You're paying them for certain services and you can assess whether they are giving you those services at the standard you require.
sentences.zh: 如果他们没有，你就解雇他们。

sentences.en: If they're not, you fire them.
sentences.zh: 如果他们工作做得好，你就留住他们。

sentences.en: If they're doing a good job, you keep them on.
sentences.zh: 这种简单性在情感关系中是不存在的。

sentences.en: There's a simplicity to that that is not present in emotional relationships.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克·哈林顿（Brooke Harrington）是丹麦哥本哈根商学院的社会学家。

sentences.en: Brooke Harrington is a sociologist at the Copenhagen Business School in Denmark.
sentences.zh: 她是《无国界资本：财富管理经理与1%的人》（Capital Without Borders, Wealth Managers, and The 1%）一书的作者。

sentences.en: She's the author of the book Capital Without Borders, Wealth Managers, and The 1%.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克，我想感谢你今天与我交谈。

sentences.en: Brooke, I want to thank you for talking with me today.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 本周的节目由玛吉·彭曼（Maggie Penman）和帕斯·沙阿（Parth Shah）制作。

sentences.en: This week's show was produced by Maggie Penman and Parth Shah.
sentences.zh: 我们的团队包括塔拉·博伊尔（Tara Boyle）、珍妮·施密特（Jenny Schmidt）、雷娜·科恩（Raina Cohen）和蕾妮·克拉尔（Renee Klar）。

sentences.en: Our team includes Tara Boyle, Jenny Schmidt, Raina Cohen, and Renee Klar.
sentences.zh: 本周，我们的无名英雄是迈克尔·卡伦（Michael Cullen）。

sentences.en: This week, our unsung hero is Michael Cullen.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔是NPR的音频工程师之一，也是那个似乎知道如何解决我们遇到的每一个技术挑战的人。

sentences.en: Michael is one of NPR's audio engineers and the person who seems to know how to solve every technical challenge we have.
sentences.zh: 本周，他花了几个小时排查我们与布鲁克·哈林顿所在的丹麦工作室之间的连接故障。

sentences.en: This week, he spent several hours troubleshooting our connection to the Danish studio where Brooke Harrington is based.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，感谢你以如此友善和冷静的态度解决了我们的技术难题。

sentences.en: Michael, thanks for fixing our technical woes with such a kind and calm demeanor.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很感激。

sentences.en: We really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢这一集，请确保订阅了这个播客，并告诉可能喜欢这个节目的朋友。

sentences.en: If you liked this episode, please make sure you're subscribed to this podcast and please tell a friend who might enjoy the show.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆（Shankar Vedantham），这是NPR。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham, and this is NPR.
sentences.zh: 再见。
